sentences.text: Have you ever felt someone walking softly just behind you?
The old tales say strange lights descend from the sky when the creature hunts.
Livestock across the province is found drained of life before the dawn arrives.
A strict old rule warns us never to answer a voice that calls your name in the dark.
A weary soldier patrolling the silent border path heard his own mother calling out to him.
He turned around and answered the voice, breaking the ancient warning.
A winged shadow dropped from the branches with glowing crimson eyes.
A sudden shriek was cut short by the crushing strike.
Only a discarded helmet and a smear of dark blood remained on the path.
